scopeLimitationsAndResiduals.statement: The v1.9 checker authenticates everything it executes, but nothing authenticates the v1.9 checker itself. A caller who obtains a tampered check-d9-v1.9.py gains no protection from its own pin list.
scopeLimitationsAndResiduals.requiredHandling: The invoking process must obtain check-d9-v1.9.py by an externally pinned hash and invoke it with -B. This is a boundary statement, not a defect: a checker cannot bootstrap its own authenticity.

scopeLimitationsAndResiduals.requiredHandling: Prefer -B for all retained-checker invocation, or add __pycache__ to a workspace ignore rule.
